title: Listening Drill — Architectural model workshop — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Architectural model workshop — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on architectural model workshop last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with warped base. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: loose corner.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of base thickness so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow foam board instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the model technician before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Saturday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
